title: Request and response contracts
description: OpenAPI 3.1.1 and SDK engineering: checked-in contract, executable assertion, red starter, instructor fix and compatibility/security limitations.
objectives: Every operation must document its media types, required request body and actual status-specific response schema; 201 and 422 have distinct meanings.
Repair the broken openapi-request-response contract exercise.
Explain the difference between an OpenAPI description and an enforced server behavior.
rubric: I understand the OpenAPI contract behind request and response contracts.
I can repair the starter and run a meaningful negative case.
I can name production validation or compatibility checks beyond this exercise.
